method: 90 real-engine games: two missions × three AI difficulties × (10 balanced + 5 attack-only) shared seeds 31–40. Common solver with angle ±2/power ±3 error. Balanced policy uses repairs, EMP, reactive shields, plus one convoy cover maneuver/protection. Attack-only never repairs or defends. No HP, position, damage or outcome injection. Engine time excludes human decision time; not a human difficulty rating.
